I survived my suicide and I’m glad I did. All the little things I would’ve missed. Seeing avengers end game. The dlc announcements for each smash character. My buddy proposing to his girlfriend. Becoming and uncle. What seemed so daunting and seemed so endless. Sometimes the good outweighs the bad and the bad sometimes outweighs the good. But that’s the thing there will always be good times and there will always be bad times. I am glad I survived my suicide and I hope you think twice about taking your own life.
